title: Decision: db_err helper to avoid orphan rule
description: lib.rs lines 174-180 define db_err() which converts rusqlite::Error to KithError::Store. This avoids violating the orphan rule (both types are external) while keeping error propagation clean via .map_err(db_err) at every rusqlite boundary. Rejected alternatives: blanket impl From would violate orphan rule; custom Result type would obscure the error variant.
